neighbours.label: the first piece of a word the tokenizer splits, where the word continues in the next token (sting|ray, second|hand, mux|es), against the same first word standing alone
fire: Divers spotted a large stingray resting on the sandy bottom.

We found a cheap secondhand sofa for the new apartment.

The old lighthouse keeper kept a logbook of every passing ship.
He sells secondhand records at the weekend market downtown.
